auth.label: HEC Token
auth.description: Splunk HTTP Event Collector token sent with the Authorization header. Configure it in Splunk Web under Settings > Data Inputs > HTTP Event Collector.

extraFields.label: HEC Base URL
extraFields.description: The HTTPS origin of your Splunk HTTP Event Collector, including its configured port.

actions.name: send_event
actions.description: Send one structured event to the connected Splunk HTTP Event Collector.

event.description: The event payload as any JSON value accepted by Splunk HEC.

time.description: The optional event timestamp in Unix epoch format.

host.description: The optional host value assigned to the event.

source.description: The optional source value assigned to the event.

sourcetype.description: The optional source type assigned to the event.

anyOf.description: A string array indexed field value.

additionalProperties.description: A string or string array indexed field value.

fields.description: Optional flat indexed fields attached to the event.

channel.description: An optional request channel UUID, required when the HEC token has indexer acknowledgement enabled.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for sending one structured Splunk HEC event.

ackID.description: The indexer acknowledgement identifier returned when acknowledgement is enabled.

outputSchema.description: The response returned by Splunk HTTP Event Collector.

actions.name: send_raw_event
actions.description: Send one raw text event to the connected Splunk HTTP Event Collector.

time.description: The optional event timestamp in Unix epoch format.

host.description: The optional host value assigned to the event.

source.description: The optional source value assigned to the event.

sourcetype.description: The optional source type assigned to the event.

channel.description: An optional request channel UUID. The connector generates a UUID v7 when omitted.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for sending one raw Splunk HEC event.

ackID.description: The indexer acknowledgement identifier returned when acknowledgement is enabled.

outputSchema.description: The response returned by Splunk HTTP Event Collector.
